EC2: Patients with diabetes [OR], Ischemic heart disease (IHD) [OR], stroke [OR], malignancy [OR] and psychiatric diseases are excluded from study.
EC3: The patients receiving vitamin supplements [OR] or who had clinical evidence for an acute illness [OR], renal dysfunction [OR], thyroid dysfunction [OR], chronic inflammatory diseases, inborn errors of [OR] homocysteine [OR], cobalamin or folate metabolism, or any other condition known to interfere with homocysteine metabolism will be excluded
EC4: Patients who are already involved in any other trial.
EC5: Patients not willing to fill consent/ assent form are also excluded from study.
